_about: The Omega42 Innovation Commons (HRP-03, ChatGPT's Historical Recovery Report 01): every innovation traced from its originating question through its mathematical foundation (register entries, records/math/results.json) to its implementation. Status is IMPLEMENTED (code in this repository that runs), PROTOTYPE (runs, scope limited) or PROPOSED (specified, not built). Published openly as prior art under Intellectual Non-Enclosure (PRIOR_ART.md); publication is evidence against later patent filings, not a guarantee that no patent will be filed. Not legal advice.

entries.title: The Strike coordinate

entries.note: The coordinate is computed from measurable features of the wording; it decides neither meaning nor truth.
